title: Life-changing
body: After being diagnosed at 41! I have downloaded the app and it truly helped me réorganise my house. As Adhders know, we cannot prioritise well, and this app (the vidéos) guides you to prioritise without overthinking! And the lives are awesome to feel part of a community and to do some chores with motivation and little hits of wonderful dopamine. Love the DubClub !! And love this app !!
author: Lisa-long-live-the-DubClub

title: Great help !
body:
Maybe adding how to make a shoppinglist? With a video to look in the pantry / fridge/ freezer first so you don’t impulsively buy everything new when you already have it at home…

That would really help me
author: lorkalientje
